description: This file defines a React hook and a utility function for progressively applying work in batches, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback. It manages UI state related to progress and supports cancellation.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages batch processing of items in a non-blocking manner, with progress callbacks and cancellation support.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller to manage UI state (running, progress, counts) for progressive batch processing.
